changes: Both real Worker adapters recover classified transient read failures only after durable remote acceptance. The original request, RuntimeAttempt, remote run and logical WorkSession remain the same; no repeated model submission.

The host atomically reserves at most two read recoveries per WorkSession, records technical_retry_count and runtime.warning, and checks original identity, Task state and stop intent before each query. Rework count is unchanged.

Backoffs are 0.1/0.5 seconds; queries have a five-second timeout and normal polls a 0.5-second interval. All recovery shares the original finite Worker deadline, with timeout constrained to 0..900 seconds exclusive of zero.
Invalid timeout configuration is rejected before preparing a durable request, avoiding a phantom unresolved attempt. Raw adapter entry points retain the same validation.

Original connection/observer references are frozen before waiting and terminal writes revalidate identity. Successful recovery proceeds through actual artifact acceptance and review waiting; exhaustion uses existing stop/drain/blocked finalization.
